name: FD6818B RF transceiver (3-wire)
desc: FD6818/FD6818B RF transceiver on the DM-32UV: 16-bit registers on a bit-banged 3-wire bus, two pages selected through REG_7FH. Byte address = register number * 2; the on-wire 7-bit address is wire_addr. Page 0 holds registers 0x00-0x7F, page 1 holds 0x80-0xFF. See the header comment for sources and conventions. Bus framing, the chip ID and a write/readback loopback were verified on a real DM-32UV (2026-10).
ds_ref: FD6818 PG 1.0.0, Interface timing, p.15; Register summary, p.56-72

blocks.name: Page 0
blocks.desc: Page 0 (REG_7FH = 0, the power-on default): registers 0x00-0x7F. Every register stock firmware touches is here.

blocks.name: Page 1
blocks.desc: Page 1 (write REG_7FH = 1 first on the 3-wire bus): registers 0x80-0xFF at wire address reg - 0x80. Stock firmware never selects this page.

registers.name: Chip ID / soft reset
registers.desc: Reads the chip identification code. Writing bit 15 is the soft reset used by the guide's configuration flow (WRITE(0x00,0x8000) then WRITE(0x00,0x0000)), even though the summary table lists REG_00H as read-only; stock firmware issues exactly that pair at the top of its default init. DEVIATION: the populated FD6818B reads 0x4819, not the guide's 0x6818 (hardware wins; no FD6818B datasheet is available, so 0x4819 is empirical). Stock never reads this register.

registers.desc: CTCSS/CDCSS-rate control word. Stock computes it in fd6818b_program_divider's caller (rf_channel_frequency_apply) as round(f * 2.064888 + 0.5) with f in 0.1 Hz, the constant stored as a double at flash 0x0307694c; 2.064888 = 2^27/65,000,000, i.e. exactly the guide's freq(Hz)*2^27/6.5e6 with a 0.1 Hz input. registers.name: Enable bits (FD6818B)
registers.desc: THE FD6818B's RX/TX/PLL/PA enable register. Not in the FD6818 guide at 0x30; every value stock writes here decodes exactly onto the guide's REG_03H layout and recommended words: 0x0000 IDLE, 0xbff1 RXON (guide RXON), 0xc1fe TXON with mic (guide TXON), 0xc3fa TXON + sidetone without mic, 0x0302 TX DSP + AF with PA driver off. Stock usually writes 0x0000 first, then the state word, as the guide prescribes for REG_03H. Hardware: 0xbff1 gives working FM receive; 0xc1fe keyed a carrier into a dummy load; 0x0302 read back exactly with no RF. Stock never touches REG_03H. The register is CONFIRMED as the enable register; the per-bit layout is INFERRED from REG_03H (only the whole words above were tested).
